title: FACET Project Glossary
description: Optional naming authority for terms of art used in record prose. It carries definitions, not contracts, anchors or lifecycle. Consumers may link exact, case-sensitive, whole-word occurrences without adding references or markup to records. Without this file, glossary checks do not run.

schema_version.description: FACET schema family this glossary was written under.

categories.description: Optional flat category list in display order. Categories have no parents or children. Terms may reference one declared category. Undeclared references and duplicate IDs are errors; unused categories produce warnings. Without categories, terms remain an ungrouped list.

terms.description: Terms in project-defined order. Each entry carries its own name and definition; names may contain spaces.

id.description: Stable category slug referenced by terms, using the taxonomy segment grammar. The display title can change without changing references.

title.description: Required display heading in the product's language, distinct from the stable category ID.

purpose.description: Optional description of which terms belong in the category.

term.description: Exact word or phrase used in record prose. Matching is case-sensitive and whole-word: Consignee and consignee are distinct, and neither matches inside a longer word. Duplicate term definitions are linter errors.

category.description: Optional reference to one declared category ID. An undeclared ID is a linter error. Absence leaves the term uncategorised and does not create an implicit Other category or assert that classification is complete.

definition.description: Meaning of the term in the product's language, including distinctions from related terms. Behavioural promises belong in record contracts rather than in this naming authority.

renderings.description: Per-locale wording for the term, keyed by locale. Core currently does not interpret or validate these values beyond this schema.
